    if = {
        limit = {
            pmg_radios_category_telephones_current > 0.0
        }
	subtract = pmg_radios_category_telephones_current
    }
}

state_telephones_consumption_if_no_pmg_radios_category = {
	value = state.sg:telephones.state_goods_consumption
    if = {
        limit = {
            pmg_radios_category_telephones_current < 0.0
        }
	add = pmg_radios_category_telephones_current
    }
